description: This file defines a utility class `JNDIConfigUtil` for loading and managing JNDI server configurations from an XML file. It provides methods to initialize configuration data, access specific server info, and encapsulates server details within an inner class.

classes.name: JNDIConfigUtil
classes.description: A final utility class that loads and provides access to JNDI server configuration details from an XML file.

classes.name: JndiServerInfo
classes.description: A data class encapsulating the properties of a JNDI server, such as provider URL, context factory, security info, etc.

methods.name: getXmlRootElement
methods.description: Reads the root element of the JNDI configuration XML file.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Populates the internal map with JNDI server info objects based on the XML configuration.

methods.name: getJndiServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the JndiServerInfo object corresponding to a given server name.

methods.name: JndiServerInfo (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a JndiServerInfo instance by extracting attributes from the XML element.
